categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Surge Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched via Surge, a multichain "Internet Capital Markets" platform designed for AI-native startups and revenue-generating businesses.

categories.name: Farming Games
categories.content: Farming game allows players to simulate farming life, focusing on activities such as planting and harvesting crops, raising livestock, and managing resources.

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.

categories.name: BagsApp Ecosystem
categories.content: BagsApp Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via bags.fm.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: PAAL AI Launchpad
categories.content: Projects incubated by PAAL AI, an AI-centric ecosystem built using Custom Data Feed and LLMs.

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Stonk Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on StonkFun.fun (https://www.stonkfun.xyz/).

categories.name: Fighting Games
categories.content: Fighting game centered around combat between two or more number of characters.

categories.name: TimeFi
categories.content: TimeFi is a blockchain-based approach to treating time as a monetizable asset through tokenized productivity, verifiable commitments, and AI-driven incentives.

categories.name: Parody Meme
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by the names of well-known brands, individuals, or cultural icons.

categories.name: Bridged Stablecoin
categories.content: Bridged stablecoin refers to a stablecoin that has been transferred, or “bridged,” from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: Bridged DAI
categories.content: Bridged DAI refers to DAI that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging'.

categories.name: Hybrid Token Standards
categories.content: Hybrid Token Standards allow tokens to have characteristics of both fungible assets and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Wojak-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to Wojak.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.
